title: Sound Hopscotch
description: Listen for a letter sound and help a fluffy bunny hop to the matching stone. Explore Meadow Hop, Sound Match, and make-your-own hop paths.
learningGoals: Map spoken consonant sounds to printed letters
Build playful sound-letter recall through repeated listening
Practice contrasts such as b/d, m/n, and f/v without penalty
interactionModel: three-mode tap-and-drag phonics play: listen, tap the matching letter stone, or build and play a custom path
feedbackModel: Correct stones sparkle and the bunny hops; misses gently wiggle, replay the sound, and offer a warm retry with no timer or game over.

modes.title: Meadow Hop
modes.skill: progressive sound-to-letter mapping across six rounds

modes.title: Sound Match
modes.skill: gentle discrimination of tricky consonant contrasts across five rounds

modes.title: Make a Path
modes.skill: sequence and replay a self-made left-to-right letter-sound path
